title: Quantico Shooting Club
specs: 54,440 acres of ranges with 55 active live and non-live fire ranges and training facilities
Ranges include rifle, pistol, tactical, shotgun, and long-distance rifle ranges up to 1000 yards
Volunteer Range Safety Officers operate ranges; 3 RSOs required to open a range
Guests must be accompanied by a member at all times and sign a liability waiver
Anyone shooting must be under constant supervision of a parent or guardian if under 18
Children 8-12 restricted except for certain matches and based on RSO evaluation
Members provide their own firearms, ammunition, targets, stands, safety gear, hydration, sunscreen, bug spray
NFA items allowed except full automatic or simulated full-auto fire
Members may bring up to three guests per day
Guests must be accompanied by a member at all times
includes: Use of rifle, pistol, tactical, and shotgun ranges
Known Distance target frames for Ranges 2, 3 & 4
gap: Exact membership prices by category not stated on provided pages
blurb: Quantico Shooting Club operates various rifle, pistol, tactical, and shotgun ranges on Marine Corps Base Quantico. The club is open on weekends only, with range availability posted weekly based on Marine Corps training schedules. Members provide their own firearms, ammunition, targets, and safety gear; the club provides clay targets for shotgun and some target frames for certain ranges.
extraNote: Ranges open only on weekends and subject to Marine Corps training schedules and RSO availability · Ranges may close or change at any time due to USMC training or RSO decisions · Guests pay $20 daily range fee; fee applies to membership if joining same day · Guest may only be a guest twice in 365 days except for match events · No firearms or ammunition rental or storage by club · Must bring own targets and stands except clay targets for shotgun and some frames for certain ranges · Strict rules on firearm transport on base; check before visiting · Clubhouse at Marine Corps Base Quantico
